text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Training on that day was conducted in her racing outfit to simulate an actual race, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, can we take a short break?
I just... can't seem to run right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Where Mejiro Dober is looking as she says that...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That racewear belongs to the Mejiro family...
Do they seem a little out of sorts?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text: Well, it looks like it's only the first lap. They're just testing the waters, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems she's bothered by the other Trainers watching the session.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I keep telling you, I just need a little rest—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You really didn't need to go that far for me...
It's just, well... I was only—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, seriously............
I hate it when you do that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I wasn't able to cheer her upvery well in her downcast state...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I wasn't able to cheer her upvery well in her downcast state...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it were the former Chief Trainer at a time like this,
would they have been able to support her more closely—
choice_data_list: (No, now's not the time to be depressed!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I searched all over the academy,
chasing after Mejiro Dober who had vanished, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I said I was fine.
choice_data_list: Sorry. I just couldn't help but worry...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Why are you the one apologizing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...No.
You don't have to apologize, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...The colors on these racing silks
are the traditional colors of the Mejiro family."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run like everyone... in the Mejiro family.
That's what I was thinking when I made this design, but..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still—once I realize people are watching me run
as a member of the Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I can't run with that overwhelming, quintessential Mejiro style
like McQueen does, so..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't live up to expectations with a proud, bright smile like Ryan does...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "As long as I'm wearing this racing attire... I can't help but be compared to the two running ahead of me..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"With how mediocre my running is...
I was worried I might bring shame to the Mejiro family..."
choice_data_list: I get it. I feel the same way.
I understand. I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...! What would you even know?!
Don't just say whatever pops into your head...!
choice_data_list: In the sense that no one can beat a great senior.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
But... what...?"
choice_data_list: In the sense that no one can beat a great senior.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“I see...... So you too, Trainer...
That kind of......”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Even so... you still won't run away...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Then I won't run away either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"When you're trying that hard, Trainer...
I can't possibly keep up with you..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nothing good comes from running away...
Besides, losing to you would just piss me off...
choice_data_list: There's no need to push yourself too hard right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah. I'll do my best too.
Together with you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: There's no need to push yourself too hard right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait, drop the act already... jeez!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, having you say that so loudly
is kind of embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was you, Dober! I happened to see
the Mejiro colors and came over without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was you, Dober! I happened to see
the Mejiro colors and came over without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What kind of training are we doing today?
It somehow feels different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah.
It's kind of like training while simulating the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... So that is what this Racewear is for.
No wonder you felt different than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, to don those colors is synonymous with carrying the Mejiro name... If so, will you allow me to test your resolve?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You mean run together with you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...If you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I'll show you my resolve...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two put on a stellar running display
during training. Their performance was so impressive
that cheers erupted from the spectator stands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, I have to take on the challenge...
choice_data_list: You can take on a challenge anywhere

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, I have to take on the challenge...
choice_data_list: You can take on a challenge anywhere

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Indeed... So, where are we doing it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... Working out in my racing outfit...
Is that fitting for the Mejiro family...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... Working out in my racing outfit...
Is that fitting for the Mejiro family...?
Sounds great to me! Working out in racing gear!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ryan...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Sorry, sorry! I was bench-pressing and happened to hear your voice, Dober, so I just couldn't resist.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Still, what I said earlier is the truth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No matter where we are, this single-minded devotion
to growing stronger... is the true duty of the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh...... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
? You're very welcome!
All right! I'm gonna give it my all too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Ryan.
...And besides...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
……I'm, y'know, grateful to you too……
I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you...
for always encouraging me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Dober worked hard on
strength training while still wearing her racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Dober worked hard on
strength training while still wearing her racing outfit.
